description:
Create a German e-invoice (ZUGFeRD PDF or XRechnung) from what the person
tells you, and get a link to download it. Works without an API key.

Invowerk checks the invoice against EN 16931 and the German rules, computes
line amounts, VAT and totals itself, and answers a link to its form, filled
in. The person opens it, sees the preview and downloads the file there. A
download costs `download_price_cents` once per invoice (VAT included, no
account needed); a plan's monthly e-invoices cover it too.

Ask the person for what is missing before you call:
- `sender`: their own business: name, street, post_code, city, and vat_id
  (USt-IdNr.) or tax_number (Steuernummer). An XRechnung also needs
  contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email and iban.
- `buyer`: name, street, post_code, city. An XRechnung also needs
  electronic_address and buyer_reference (the Leitweg-ID).
- `number`, `issue_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), and `due_date` or `payment_terms`.
- `lines`: name, quantity, net_price (net, per unit), unit_code (C62 piece,
  HUR hour, DAY day, KGM, MTR, LTR, MTK, H87), tax_category and tax_rate:
  S at 19 or 7; Z, E, AE and K at 0. E needs an exemption_reason; AE (reverse
  charge) and K (intra-EU supply) need buyer.vat_id.
- `output`: "zugferd" (a PDF, for businesses) or "xrechnung" (XML, for public
  bodies). `small_business: true` for a Kleinunternehmer (§ 19 UStG): every
  line without VAT. `type_code`: 380 invoice (default), 326 partial invoice,
  381 credit note, 384 correction (needs preceding_invoice), 875/876/877
  construction invoices.
Never choose categories, rates or amounts for the person: Invowerk checks the
format, not the tax.

Returns `url`, `output`, `number`, `totals` (the amounts Invowerk writes),
`findings` (warnings of the check) and `download_price_cents` with
`currency`. Give the person `url` exactly as returned, as a link. The invoice
travels after its `#`, which browsers never send to a server, so Invowerk
stores nothing. Input that cannot become a valid invoice fails with an error
listing each field and what is wrong: fix those, asking the person where
needed, and call again.

Credits: free. This tool is not metered.

invoice.description: The invoice as the person states it: output, number, issue_date, sender (the person's own business), buyer, lines (quantity, net_price, tax_category, tax_rate) and the optional fields. Invowerk computes every amount itself.

items.description: One invoice line (BG-25). The line net amount is computed, never given.

anyOf.description: The ONE earlier invoice this one refers to (BG-3).

sender.description:
The seller (BG-4): the business that issues the invoice. The browser keeps
it in ``localStorage``, logo included.

invoice.title: CreatorInvoice

lang.description: Language of the form the link opens: "de" (default) or "en".
